screenshots.description: CureMD SMART Cloud EHR full application: top nav header (Personal, Patient, Scheduler, Billing, Claims), left clinical module tree sidebar (Registration, Provider Notes, Clinical, Orders & Results, etc.), patient banner (H phone, Allergy NKDA, Primary Plan Empire BCBS, plan/patient balance), and Physical Exam (Neck) work area with body diagrams, surface/trachea/lymph node checklists.

CureMD SMART Cloud EHR (Dermatology Center) full application: top nav header, left clinical module tree sidebar, patient banner (email jessica.jones@aol.com, Allergy NKDA, Primary Plan Empire BCBS, balances), and Physical Exam Body Chart work area showing diagnoses (Basal Cell Carcinoma, Neoplasm Uncertain Behavior) on anatomical body diagrams.

CureMD Patient Portal (CureMD Medical Center) full application: header with practice info, left navigation menu (My Health: History, Diagnoses, Medications, Labs; My Appointments; My Alerts; My Doctor), and main work area with patient demographics, diagnoses, medications, allergies, complaints, lab result trend chart, and recent vitals.
